title: FNAF Camera Flip
blurb: Tablet static, and the security monitor comes up. It sounds like nothing, and it is completely load-bearing: in Five Nights at Freddy's the camera flip is both your only source of information and the reason you cannot see the hallway in front of you. Every check is a trade. Players learned to flick up and down in tiny nervous bursts, and this clipped hiss became the metronome of the entire game. Works beautifully as a scene-change sting, or as the sound of somebody checking something they would rather not confirm.
origin: The camera monitor flip-up sound from Five Nights at Freddy's.
